comments.body:
Fine tribs sizes always have puzzled me in how they work can someone tell me if they know

Or

Are they saying if I myself am in a light ship then I can use fine tribs for light ships

My other question lets say im in a light ship and my fleet member is in a large ship can I use fine trib light to end the attack or must I use a fine trib large ship to end it.

Its not a sailing game its a game of discovery now discover how these things work lol

comments.author: Blake.C
comments.body:
1. The size to use depends on the ship size YOU are using, not the pirate's. You can also use the Fine Tribute Goods for larger ships if your sailing in a smaller ship then it was designed for, but not vice versa.

2. The size to use in that case is determined who has the largest ship size, no matter if their the admiral or not. If someone in the fleet has a heavy ship for example, then the one for Large Ships will only work. I'm guessing otherwise players could get around it by carrying an alt with a light ship, and then using the more easily obtainable Fine Tribute Goods for light ships to get out of a pirate attack.

One more thing to note: Regardless who uses the Fine Tribute Good, EVERYONE in the fleet will have half their money [that they have on person] taken away and be given a green flag.
